text_block_list.text:
—...Onii-chan, Onii-chan, wake up?
Come on, Onii-chan.

—...Onee-chan, Onee-chan, wake up?
Come on, Onee-chan.

Through a haze of overwhelming fatigue, I opened my eyes—and saw a girl in a black-and-white outfit standing amidst the light.
Exuding a mysterious charm, she smiled gently...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, if that's what Onii-chan wants,
I can be an angel or a devil for you♪
But for now—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, if that's what Onee-chan wants,
I can be an angel or a devil for you♪
But for now—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Chop!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're finally awake.
Good morning-afternoon, sleepyhead Onii-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're finally awake.
Good morning-afternoon, sleepyhead Onee-chan♪

I was snapped back to reality by a chop.
It seems I was dozing off, but...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...Big Bro, don't tell me
you don't remember?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...Big Sis, don't tell me
you don't remember?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Look, it's Curren's racing outfit!
We made it together, remember?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Well, bro passed out the moment it was finished, so I guess it can't be helped~.
You must've worked super hard.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Well, sis passed out the moment it was finished, so I guess it can't be helped~.
You must've worked super hard.

What in the world had happened to me...?
I recall looking at the sample racewear that arrived with Curren Chan a few days ago—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Not enough.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, the racing outfit itself is super lovely.
It's just as Curren pictured it,
and I can really tell the artisans put their hearts into it."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
But—it's still not enough.
Curren's racing outfit has to have that extra-special 'cuteness.'

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
From here on, it's about meeting Curren herself halfway.
So we've gotta work it out on our own!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, Onii-chan, I have a favor to ask.
Will you grant Curren's selfish wish~...?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, Onee-chan, I have a favor to ask.
Will you grant Curren's selfish wish~...?"

"...Right, now I remember!
Back then, inspired by Curren Chan's strong will—"
choice_data_list: (Heading to the sea in search of legendary fabric...)
(Deep into the mountains to find the miraculous dye...)

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
—You see, that fabric is made from pearls.
They say in a certain sea, there are pearls that give off a stunning glow when ground up and woven into cloth.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Even so, it's not like it's visibly glowing or anything,
it's more like, if you know, you know.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
“Just imagine it, though. That mystical radiance Curren gives off as she runs...
Think about what an unforgettable impression that would leave!”

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
That's why Curren wants to be picky about it!
Big Brother, come go get it with me!
Pleeease!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
That's why Curren wants to be picky about it!
Big Sister, come go get it with me!
Pleeease!
And so, arriving at the secluded, unexplored sea—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Apparently you can only get them by free-diving.
Can Curren really do it, I wonder...?
I'm a little anxious...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Really!? How dependable♪
Then Curren will cheer
for you with all her might!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Go, go, Big Brother♪
Fight! Fight!
Right there! Pass 'em, pass 'em!♪"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Go, big sis, go go~♪
Fight, fight!
Right there, overtake 'em, overtake 'em~♪

Diving down again and again, completely exhausted,
I managed to find the pearl Curren Chan wished for—

I somehow managed to finish Curren Chan's Racewear...
It all came rushing back to me!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to all your hard work, Big Brother,
my racing outfit turned out so wonderful.
Thank you♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to all your hard work, Big Sis,
my racing outfit turned out absolutely wonderful.
Thank you♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Sooo... what do you think?
Does Curren look cute after getting all dolled up with Big Brother?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Sooo... what do you think?
Does Curren look cute after getting all dolled up with Big Sister?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, wonderful♪
Curren is super satisfied too.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: "Let's win loooots and lots of races together in this outfit, Big Brother♪"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: "Let's win loooots and lots of races together in this outfit, Big Sister♪"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
—For Curren's race outfit, I want to be picky about the dye.
Ordinary colors wouldn't do Curren justice.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You know, they say there's a flower deep in the mountains
that has been living for 1,000 years.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
They say that dyeing clothes with that flower yields
the exact shade you desire, producing a color so captivating
that it enchants anyone who lays eyes upon it.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Still, it sounds like you have to get through tons of traps before you can actually reach it...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"It might be a dangerous journey.
But... Curren really, really needs that flower!
Please, will you come with me?"

Her resolve and passion come through loud and clear...
Even so, I can't let her walk into danger.
For now, I should—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Really?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"I'm happy, but~...
Are you okay on your own?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Then... Curren will be waiting,
so don't be too late, okay?
I'm trusting you, Big Brother!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Then... Curren will be waiting,
so don't be too late, okay?
I'm trusting you, Big Sister!

And so, heading alone into the deep, uncharted mountains...
and surviving countless deadly perils so fierce
that I can't even remember anything—

I somehow managed to finish Curren Chan's Racewear...
It all came rushing back to me!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
What do you think?
Is the current Curren...
capturing Onii-chan's heart?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
What do you think?
Is the current Curren...
capturing Onee-chan's heart?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I'm so glad.
Because you worked so hard for me, Big Bro,
Curren is definitely going to make her dream come true!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I'm so glad.
You know, because you worked so hard for me, Big Sis,
Curren is definitely going to make her dream come true!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"With this outfit, I'll capture everyone's hearts
even more, and I'll never let go.
So you too, Big Brother—"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"With this outfit, I'll capture everyone's hearts
even more, and I'll never let go.
So you too, Big Sister—"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Keep letting Curren steal your heart away...♪
